question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Abrogate
solution:
The correct answer is **"Establish."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Abrogate"** means to abolish or cancel something, while establish means to create or set up something. (किसी चीज़ को ख़त्म करना या रद्द करना, जबकि स्थापित करने का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को बनाना या स्थापित करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The treaty was **abrogated**__ in 1929.*
 
 
 
• **"Abrogate"** and **"Establish"** are antonyms.
 
• **"Establish"** means to start or create an organization, a system, etc. (संस्‍था, व्‍यवस्‍था आदि स्‍थापित करना, निर्धारित करना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The school was **established**__ in 1875.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (Eradicate)** means to completely destroy or eliminate something. ((रोग आदि) को जड़ से उखाड़ देना, पूर्णतया उन्‍मूलित कर देना)
 
• **Option 3 (Demoralise)** means to cause someone to lose confidence or morale. (किसी का मनोबल गिराना या उत्‍साहभंग करना (कि वह काम करना बंद कर दे))
 
• **Option 4 (Sabotage)** means to deliberately destroy or damage something. (जान-बूझ कर तोड़-फोड़ करना)
